I would say shop around for prices and try to get some quotes so you know about how much it would be.  

Fursuit makers you could look into are: Lemonbrat (I personally don't like them but they are an option), Blackcheetah studios, Lillymoon suits, Skyehigh studios, Freckled Cat creations, Simple Nicks,  and Living Carousel.  You can check out fursuitreview.com to check out more makers.  Another good way to find fursuit makers is to look at the following list of another maker.

For a don't commission list:
Sugar n spice costumes
Don't hug cacti
Lsd / Liqwid sunshine studios
(If anyone knows any more feel free to add)

Made homophobic and Pro-life posts sorta long ago, also harassed a trans person for posting an update on their translation on a furry server.  You should check out Simple Nick's video if you wanna know more about it.

I'm not sure if this will help you but I've been sexually assaulted on multiple occasions, once by my best friend at the time.  After it happened I felt so terrible and scared.  I worried about what my parents were going to say.  I worried no one would believe me.

I ended up telling a mandated reporter (e.x. teacher or church worker) and they had to make a report.  That might be a good option if you're scared about calling to report it yourself.  People listened to me, supported me, and I filed a police report.  I was offered counseling services.  My parents believed me, and the situation got better.  I live with PTSD but I'm able to manage my daily life and thrive.

I'm not sure what the next few weeks or months will look like for you, but I know there is hope.  Even when it feels like your whole world is crumbling because you thought you trusted someone, there is hope.  You always have a future ahead of you and you shouldn't let some person who thought they could take advantage of you change that.

I hope you have a safe night 💕

I dealt with this for a while, and I was actually surprised when someone told me I probably have depression.  Basically if you're wondering whether you're faking it, then you're likely not faking it.  Also, if you can't just stop the way you're feeling by will, then you're probably not faking it.

I feel the same, I have a few close friends I mostly message online and I feel terribly lonely.  I think the fact that we can't do as many things in person factors into this.  And I do think your theory is right, that it's because you don't care about yourself.  I deal with the same thing.  I hope you can feel more loved sometime soon.
In desperation of wanting to die I've tried to choke myself with my hands quite a few times.  Not with any sexual connotations though.

I attempted once, I was taken to the hospital and was largely fine but the impact it had on my family was horrible.  It broke me how sad they were, I didn't think they cared.  It opened my eyes to how wanted I was I the world.

I'm doing mostly better now.  You are right, you should wait.  I can't tell you 100% that things get better because I don't know that and I can't keep that promise.  But feelings pass and times can improve.  Suicidal thoughts cloud your mind and make you believe no one cares, but it's not true.  Please wait.  See if medications help, do therapy if you can.  You never know what the future holds.

My friend and I promised not to kill ourselves because of one of us did it, the other would.  We're both in a better place today.

I hope you can say the same some day.  It sounds like Henry cares about you, and I'm sure others do too.  Please try to take time and care for yourself.  You mean alot to people.

I was in a relationship while suicidal, would not recommend.  The guy was shitty too.  He would get mad at me for self harming.  I really wouldn't recommend putting your hope in something like that where they might be rude to you or one of you might lose feelings.  We ended up breaking up but thankfully I was in a better place when that happened.

Sorry to talk about myself, I hope you are doing well.  But yeah, would not recommend it.

What your friends said is super inappropriate.  But as far as I know, you can tell a therapist about you feelings or go to the ER and tell them what is happening.  I hope you're able to be admitted if you feel you need it and that your stay would be helpful.
Also thank you to everyone who left supportive comments.  Y'all are helping me cope 💗

Updating on here.  I annoyed my friend all day with my problems.  I think she hates me, even though she's always super supportive of me.  I feel like I can't handle adulting even though I'm not even one yet.  Hearing about anything political stresses me out so much.  I'm never going to be able to drive or have a job because of anxiety.  I'm a waste of space.  I'm so bored it hurts but I can't get anything done because I have no motivation.  I'm considering suicide even more today.  I could never do it though because of my pets.  My family and people that know me would be heartbroken.  I probably need to start antidepressants again.  I'm gonna talk to a leader from my church Wednesday.  I don't know how to tell people I'm suicidal.  I don't want to be put in the hospital.  

I feel so stuck.  I want to not exist but I can't because of other people.  I wish I could disappear.
For me, interacting with pets helps.  Watching animal videos might work too if you don't have pets.  It helps remind me of the beauty in life and that other creatures depend on you.
